families.name: Explore
families.body: Records with parents, and flat lists of any size.

families.name: Plan
families.body: The same records as cards on a board, on a calendar, a plan or a timeline.

families.name: Compare
families.body: State across two sets, what changed between snapshots, and how it moved over time.

families.name: Guide
families.body: Steps, routes and layers the host explains before it acts.

families.name: Deliver
families.body: The same view as plain HTML for mail and print.

views.name: Tree grid
views.body: Expandable branches with lazy children, path search, filters that keep the tree's shape, detail rows and checkboxes.

views.name: Data grid
views.body: Typed sorting and filters, facets, grouping with aggregates, pinned columns, saved views, editing and export.

views.name: Pivot
views.body: Nested row and column axes with totals, collapse, top N with Other, and drill-through to the matching records.

views.name: Board
views.body: Records as cards in status lanes, with swimlanes, WIP limits and moves the host approves like any edit.

views.name: Calendar
views.body: Month, week, day, agenda and year views of grid records, with recurrence, time zones and iCalendar export.

views.name: Plan
views.body: Tasks on a timeline per team, with a baseline, milestones, dependencies and the conflicts between them.

views.name: Resource timeline
views.body: Resources as a tree with capacity per group, events on a scrolling time axis, and rescheduling by drag.

views.name: Status matrix
views.body: A state for each pair of two sets, with totals, grouping and sorting on both axes and both axes windowed.

views.name: Change review
views.body: A change list with risk flags and reasons, propagation to each replica, and inline or side-by-side diffs.

views.name: Dataset compare
views.body: Two snapshots matched by key: what was added, removed and changed, with before and after in each cell.

views.name: Time slider
views.body: Snapshots the host supplies, replayed on a matrix or a propagation view with play, step and a timeline.

views.name: Guided flow
views.body: Steps with typed fields, conditions as data, live checks, a review page and one proposal handed to the host.

views.name: Approval path
views.body: The route a request takes as hops over records, with returns, team handovers and retired steps marked.

views.name: Layer stack
views.body: Layers in processing order with the one that wins, and which were enforced or filtered out, and why.

views.name: Script-free table
views.body: Script-free tables from the same view definition, with inline styles that survive mail clients, print and Word.

shared.name: Record panel
shared.body: Open any record in tabs and sections, with links, timelines and deep links.

shared.name: Linked views
shared.body: A chart, list or grid filters or highlights another view.

shared.name: Calculated columns
shared.body: Formulas over other columns, without eval, that sort, filter, group and export.

shared.name: Buckets and display modes
shared.body: Group dates by month or numbers by range, and show totals as a share, a change or a rank.

shared.name: View proposals
shared.body: The host suggests a grouping, filter or pivot; the reader previews it before applying.

shared.name: Search highlighting
shared.body: Matches marked in place, with a count and next and previous.

shared.name: Saved views
shared.body: Named layouts keep columns, filters, sorting and grouping.

shared.name: Export
shared.body: CSV built in; Excel and PDF writers that work offline, with the same scope choice.

shared.name: Editing
shared.body: Typed editors, validation, undo, and commits your host saves.

shared.name: Conditional formatting
shared.body: Data bars, colour scales and badges from filter conditions.

shared.name: Layout modes
shared.body: Fit, scroll sideways or switch to cards, in three densities.

shared.name: Six languages
shared.body: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French and Italian label packs.

shared.name: Strict security
shared.body: Runs under CSP without unsafe-inline and with Trusted Types.

shared.name: Accessibility
shared.body: ARIA grid and tree roles, a full keyboard model, forced colours.

shared.name: Virtual rows
shared.body: Only visible rows are in the page, so 100,000 nodes stay quick.

shared.name: Embedded chrome
shared.body: Drop the frame so a view sits inside a card or a dashboard tile.
